work_identified: Utriusque cosmi majoris scilicet et minoris metaphysica, physica atque technica historia — Robert Fludd's encyclopedic Latin work on the macrocosm and microcosm, published in multiple volumes 1617–1621 (Oppenheim/Frankfurt, de Bry). Distinct from Fludd's later Philosophia Moysaica (Englished as 'Mosaicall Philosophy', 1659).
